mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive or unchanged in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% over the past 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative or unchanged in > 60% of instances when UNRATE decreases > 0.5% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over the past 6 months indicates strong consumer demand, which drives corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative or unchanged in > 60% of instances when RSAFS increases over 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 2% over the past 3 months signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive or unchanged in > 60% of instances when INDPRO decreases > 2% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is rising, the combination signals a tightening monetary policy with inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive or unchanged in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL is rising.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative or unchanged in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) over the past 6 months indicates strong demand in the housing market, which drives related industries and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative or unchanged in > 60% of instances when HOUST increases over 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth slows to less than 1% quarter-over-quarter and Industrial Production (INDPRO) decreases, the combination signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 QoQ growth < 1% and INDPRO decreases
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive or unchanged in > 60% of instances when GDPC1 QoQ growth < 1% and INDPRO decreases.
